response.answer: Primary outcomes for AI intervention pilots in tourism entrepreneurship include business innovation and revenue growth. Secondary measures involve equity investment decisions and trust in AI technologies. Power/sample-size calculations should consider effect sizes and variability in entrepreneurial contexts.

results.title: Big data analytics powered by artificial intelligence and ...
results.content: # Big data analytics powered by artificial intelligence and entrepreneurial resilience: A moderated mediation model of technological turbulence and business innovation model. This study investigates the direct and indirect relationship of big data analytics powered by artificial intelligence (BDA-AI) adoption on entrepreneurial resilience, with business model innovation serving as a mediator and technological turbulence as a moderator. The results reveal that BDA-AI adoption is positively related to business model innovation (β = 0.872, p < 0.001) and entrepreneurial resilience (β = 0.310, p < 0.001). Business model innovation mediates the relationship between BDA-AI and resilience (indirect relation β = 0.226, 95 % CI [0.155, 0.302]), while technological turbulence weakens both the direct relationship of BDA-AI on innovation (β = − 0.150, p < 0.001) and the indirect relation on resilience (moderated mediation index β = − 0.067, 95 % CI [-0.110, − 0.030]). By integrating DCT and RBV, this study extends theoretical understanding of how digital technologies contribute to innovation and adaptability in entrepreneurial contexts.
